briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF L-004
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- water tower top: (-121, -60), roof
- office roof: (-4, 149), roof
- control room: (79, -91), indoor
- electrical room: (-140, 26), indoor
- storage hall: (-40, 122), indoor
- gate 2: (-52, -91), outdoor
- water tank: (6, 44), outdoor
- parking lot: (22, 113), outdoor
- fuel depot: (-134, -23), outdoor
- east fence: (104, 141), outdoor

Robots:
- G1 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 15 kg), camera, thermal camera. Endurance: 3780 s, including the return to its start.
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1200 s, including the return to its start.
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 6.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1320 s, including the return to its start.
- G2 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 21 kg), camera, thermal camera. Endurance: 5160 s, including the return to its start.
- G3 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 28 kg), camera. Endurance: 5340 s, including the return to its start.
- G4 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 16 kg), camera. Endurance: 3840 s, including the return to its start.
- D3 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1320 s, including the return to its start.
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 10 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2940 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Tighten the valve at control room. Location: control room. Duration: 150 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 1260 s.
- T2: Run a thermal scan of water tank. Location: water tank. Duration: 180 s. Needs: thermal camera.
- T3: Deliver the toolkit (13 kg) to gate 2. Location: gate 2. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 13 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 240 s.
- T4: Replace the filter cartridge at control room. Location: control room. Duration: 240 s. Needs: robotic arm. Can start only after T13 is finished.
- T5: Tighten the valve at east fence. Location: east fence. Duration: 240 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T6: Run a thermal scan of parking lot. Location: parking lot. Duration: 210 s. Needs: thermal camera. Deadline: finished by t = 600 s.
- T7: Inspect water tower top with a camera. Location: water tower top. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera.
- T8: Photograph water tank for the condition report. Location: water tank. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera.
- T9: Collect a soil sample (3 kg) at gate 2 and keep it on board. Location: gate 2. Duration: 60 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 3 kg).
- T10: Photograph electrical room for the condition report. Location: electrical room. Duration: 60 s. Needs: camera.
- T11: Tighten the valve at gate 2. Location: gate 2. Duration: 300 s. Needs: robotic arm. Can start only after T3 is finished.
- T12: Tighten the valve at gate 2. Location: gate 2. Duration: 270 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T13: Deliver the first-aid kit (6 kg) to control room. Location: control room. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 6 kg).
- T14: Deliver the battery pack (9 kg) to control room. Location: control room. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 9 kg).
- T15: Deliver the toolkit (13 kg) to parking lot. Location: parking lot. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 13 kg).
- T16: Deliver the toolkit (2 kg) to gate 2. Location: gate 2. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 2 kg).

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Every task must be finished by t = 2700 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Hi team, here is today's job at the site.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: water tower top (-121, -60, a rooftop); office roof (-4, 149, a rooftop); control room (79, -91, indoors); electrical room (-140, 26, indoors); storage hall (-40, 122, indoors); gate 2 (-52, -91, outside); water tank (6, 44, outside); parking lot (22, 113, outside); fuel depot (-134, -23, outside); east fence (104, 141, outside).

The fleet: G1 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 15 kg at 2 m/s and runs for 63 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera and a thermal camera. D1, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera, cruises at 7.5 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 20 minutes of flight time, return trip included. D2 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 6.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 22 minutes including the flight home. G2 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 21 kg at 1.5 m/s and runs for 86 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera and a thermal camera. G3 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 28 kg at 2.5 m/s and runs for 89 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. G4 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 16 kg at 2.5 m/s and runs for 64 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. D3 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 7.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 22 minutes including the flight home. M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 10 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 49 minutes including getting back.

Jobs:
(T1) The valve at control room needs tightening - that takes 2.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 21 minutes.
(T2) Check water tank for hot spots - that takes 3 minutes on site.
(T3) Drop the toolkit off at gate 2; it weighs 13 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 4 minutes.
(T4) Change the filter at control room - that takes 4 minutes on site but only once the first-aid kit (T13) has arrived.
(T5) Someone has to tighten the valve at east fence - that takes 4 minutes on site.
(T6) Do a heat check over parking lot - that takes 3.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 10 minutes.
(T7) Do a visual check of water tower top - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T8) Document water tank with pictures - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T9) Pick up a soil sample at gate 2 and keep it on board; it weighs 3 kg - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T10) We need pictures of electrical room for the report - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T11) The valve at gate 2 needs tightening - that takes 5 minutes on site but only once the toolkit (T3) has arrived.
(T12) The valve at gate 2 needs tightening - that takes 4.5 minutes on site.
(T13) Drop the first-aid kit off at control room; it weighs 6 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T14) Control room needs the battery pack, which weighs 9 kg - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T15) Parking lot needs the toolkit, which weighs 13 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T16) Drop the toolkit off at gate 2; it weighs 2 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.

Everything has to be wrapped up within 45 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
